visual_goal: Show that the patterns form chains: upstream root patterns on the left feed downstream dealer-visible symptoms on the right.
prompt: A left-to-right chain illustration with two columns of rounded tiles and short, straight, non-crossing arrows. Right column, blue symptom tiles from top to bottom: 'Cloned Identity', 'Sticky Error', 'Leaky Lead', 'Zombie Listing', 'Borrowed Uptime'. Left column, orange root tiles, each placed at the height of the tiles it feeds: 'Acquisition Archipelago' level with 'Cloned Identity'; 'Provenance Amnesia' level with 'Sticky Error'; 'Feed Roulette' level between 'Leaky Lead' and 'Zombie Listing'; 'DMS Hostage' level between 'Zombie Listing' and 'Borrowed Uptime'. Exactly seven arrows: a straight arrow from 'Acquisition Archipelago' to 'Cloned Identity' labeled 'two keys'; a short vertical arrow on the right from 'Cloned Identity' down to 'Sticky Error'; a straight arrow from 'Provenance Amnesia' to 'Sticky Error'; from 'Feed Roulette' one arrow slanting slightly up to 'Leaky Lead' and one slanting slightly down to 'Zombie Listing'; from 'DMS Hostage' one arrow slanting slightly up to 'Zombie Listing' and one slanting slightly down to 'Borrowed Uptime'. No arrows cross. These nine tile labels and one arrow label are the only words in the image.
alt: Root patterns (Acquisition Archipelago, Provenance Amnesia, Feed Roulette, DMS Hostage) feed downstream symptoms (Cloned Identity, Sticky Error, Zombie Listing, Leaky Lead, Borrowed Uptime).
